approval_ref: Reference Trunk Tools-style file-grounded construction questions and continue improving CIRP efficiency, accuracy and adaptability across RFI, Submittal and Email content.
notes: Reuse the existing Ask the project flow rather than create a second chat system.
Recognize only strict direct Subject questions naming one exact RFI or Submittal.
Use the complete workflow index to bound primary form documents and existing non-vision evidence.
Answer one distinct explicit Subject locally with exact citations and block conflicting values.
Do not let an Email Subject satisfy an RFI or Submittal form Subject.
Fall through to ordinary grounded Q&A when no supported Subject exists.
Use synthetic evidence and make no provider request.
title: Answer exact workflow Subject questions locally
objective: Reduce latency and model cost for exact RFI/Submittal Subject questions without weakening source identity, conflict or Email boundaries.
